item.title: Dog trainer facing felony animal abuse charges after dogs suffered injuries
item.description: In Eaton County, Michigan, Samantha Sullinger pleaded not guilty to felony charges on Thursday after one-year-old golden retriever Baylor allegedly suffered severe injuries at her Potterville facility.
